product.title: Dowinx Big and Tall Office Chair with Pocket Spring Cushion,High Back Computer Gaming Chairs with Adjustable Armrests,Executive Desk Chairs with Lumbar Support and Footrest,PU -White
bulletPoints: Double-Layered Thickened Backrest: This big and tall office chair features a dual-layer backrest design with a soft cushioning layer and a supportive layer, offering enhanced comfort and ergonomic support even during extended periods of sitting

Individual Pocket Springs:The seat cushion is composed of pocket springs, a type of spring commonly used in sofas. Each spring operates independently, offering elasticity and support by adapting to pressure and contouring to your body's weight, providing a luxurious and comfortable experience akin to that of a sofa

Flexible Adjustability: This executive chair offers a reclining range from 90° to 135°, accommodating various activities whether you’re working or relaxing. Additionally, the adjustable padded armrests can be set to your preferred height, ensuring personalized comfort and support

PU Leather or Tech Cloth Options: Choose between classic PU leather for a sleek, modern look or breathable tech cloth for a softer, more comfortable feel. Both materials offer unique benefits to suit your style and preferences

Durability and Longevity: This task chair is built with high-quality materials and robust construction, ensuring it can withstand daily use and maintain its performance over time.And we also have a one-year repair service and after-sales service
